claims: Tommy Lloyd is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Arizona.
Tommy Lloyd has held the position of head men's basketball coach at the University of Arizona since April 2021.
Tommy Lloyd's first five seasons as head coach extend through April 2026.
Tommy Lloyd led the Wildcats to a Final Four appearance in his first five seasons.
Tommy Lloyd led the Wildcats to multiple conference titles in his first five seasons.
The Wildcats have a 148-35 record under Tommy Lloyd in his first five seasons.
Tommy Lloyd signed a contract extension through the 2031 season.
